chunks: Whatever is in it from Abū Zakariyyā al-Aʿwar, I have narrated it from Aḥmad ibn Ziyād ibn Jaʿfar al-Hamadānī—may Allah be pleased with him—from ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm ibn Hāshim, from Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā ibn ʿUbayd, from Abū Zakariyyā al-Aʿwar.

key_terms.أَبِي زَكَرِيَّا الْأَعْوَرِ: Abū Zakariyyā al-Aʿwar, the narrator to whom this transmission chain leads
key_terms.أَحْمَدَ بْنِ زِيَادِ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ الْه: Aḥmad ibn Ziyād ibn Jaʿfar al-Hamadānī, a transmitter in the sanad/isnad
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I transmitted it; indicating the author's act of narration
key_terms.عَلِيِّ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ هَاشِمٍ: ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm ibn Hāshim, a transmitter in the sanad/isnad
key_terms.مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى بْنِ عُبَيْدٍ: Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā ibn ʿUbayd, a transmitter in the sanad/isnad

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to Abū Zakariyyā al-Aʿwar in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the sanad/isnad by which the author transmits reports from Abū Zakariyyā al-Aʿwar. It serves as a chain-of-transmission notice in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh, documenting the route of narration through named transmitters.
